notes.title: Launch Date, Features, and Final Playtest!
notes.content:
Deducto 2 Launches on June 15th! 🚀

💲 Only $5 USD
After careful consideration, we've set the price for Deducto 2 at an affordable $5. Our goal is to make the game accessible to as many players as possible while still fairly compensating our hardworking team. We hope you're as excited about this as we are!


🚫 No Microtransactions
Deducto 2 will not include microtransactions. Instead, players can unlock most in-game cosmetics using DBucks, an in-game currency earned through progression. While we don't plan to add microtransactions, we will offer a post-launch DLC called the "VIP Bundle." This bundle may include exclusive cosmetics, parkour courses, and a community status symbol, among other rewards!


🗺️ Revamped Maps
Deducto 2 brings you updated Office & Construction Maps, featuring new tasks, layout changes, and more. We're also excited to introduce an all-new map: Courthouse!


⚖️ The Courthouse
Put your friends' testimonies to the test in the exciting new Courthouse map, which offers fresh tasks, a new jail system, and the Judge role.


🧟 Infected Mode Update
Initially, we announced an Infected Mode for Deducto 2. However, after further development, we've decided not to include it at launch. Game development often requires changes in direction, and we felt this mode wasn't meeting our expectations. We may revisit the idea in the future, but it's not part of our current plan.


🎯 Final Playtest
📅 Mark your calendars for the last playtest before launch, taking place on the weekend of May 26th! 📅 The playtest will feature only the Courthouse map. Your feedback will be invaluable in helping us prepare for launch, so please join the playtest and share your thoughts, feedback, and bug reports.

Join our community on Discord! 🎉

notes.title: ANNOUNCING DEDUCTO 2
notes.content:
I am thrilled to announce that we are making a sequel!
Check out Deducto.... 2!!!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/d38530adfa52446f6416b9f5dc56319ba10d5deb.png





Order in the Court!!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/24c4bdecd27531e33d5def3369045f58df44ddd4.gif


New cosmetics and progression system!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/478f2bff3464c4c401c0f9824eb4ab1506abd358.gif


Daily Parkour Courses!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/16aebeb0e838b46dd958d3983e9d944ffc214cf6.gif

Additional Deducto 2 Features:

Infected Mode
Customizable Desks
New Tasks & Items
Map Improvements
And more!



Why make a sequel?
We wanted to make sweeping changes that would be too disruptive to put in an update. Changes such as a new parkour system, reworked maps, a new cosmetic system, and a character with different feeling movement. By making a sequel, we can preserve Deducto 1 as a great free-to-play option, and it allows us to spend the needed time to make big changes for a new-and-improved Deducto 2.

Will Deducto 2 cost money?
Yes, it will cost around $5-$10 USD.

Will all my DLC hats transfer over?
No, however, there will be exclusive items for those that purchased Deducto 1 DLC. We will also have new cosmetics unlockable through gameplay.

What does this mean for Deducto 1?
Deducto 1 will continue receiving small updates and bug fixes. We won't be releasing any more maps for Deducto 1. I'm proud of how much content we created for Deducto 1, and you can look forward to more coming in the sequel!



Please wishlist! It helps support us and helps the game's visibility on steam!

notes.title: Construction Update
notes.content:
Rebranding {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/8f5216db6281d9847a68afd7e9bcd8f0a090ed59.png

With this update, we are altering the name from Deduction -> Deducto!
The reason is simple - it's about uniqueness and searchability. Our game is hard to find online because "Deduction" is such a commonly used word. When searching for it on youtube, for example, you might get tax deduction content or videos related to any of the other social deduction games.

Naming a social deduction game "Deduction" was kind of like naming an FPS game "Shooter".
The new name will really help us grow and reach more players, I hope you guys like it!


Construction Map {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/e8a7f22e3c3768bb84844689bcf68023f6767cdb.png
Tired of being stuck in the office? If you are looking for a position where you get to work with your hands - this job site might be the one for you! It features indoor and outdoor spaces, as well as underground pipes that imposters can utilize. This map is also significantly larger with more paths to get around.


Supervisor Role {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/54df8e3d0cdb4923fcb04864d9754316e942e039.png
The supervisors are the only ones that get a vote in this new gamemode! It is their job to keep track of who's doing their tasks and figure out who the killers are. If all the supervisors are killed, a random co-worker will be promoted to take their place!


New Items {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/2e3db67424e0d47417843b23bdd9e4b0ad66768c.png
Nail Gun This new imposter weapon fires full auto, dealing 25 damage per hit. The sound of it firing strikes fear into the hearts of co-workers, much like the nails that it fires.

Gas Can This item is a useful tool for co-workers to fill vehicles with gas, while the imposters use it for a different purpose...

Disguise Imposters have access to this item that can conceal their identity. If they use it too much, it may be obvious who wasn't accounted for during the round.


Female Character {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/8667f7a834d4bb733e557176b03a172e7184d63a.png
I'm happy to announce you can now play as a female! All hats and hairstyles are available to both female and male characters.

notes.title: Optimization Update
notes.content:
Summary
Deduction suffered from lighting inefficiencies which dragged frame rates down, and GPU usage up. This update provides massive improvements on both fronts!


Framerate Comparsion your mileage may vary, but here are the results of my testing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/33a3debbc31835ed774bf8b765d3a4e06700199a.png


Lighting Improvements as a result of optimization, the game can now handle way better lighting!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/f926f1e104381c3196a3adbec814d800ad51041b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/1731a347974b087988d83bb6e20559ae651dae42.png


New Graphics Settings Limit FPS is the important one that was previously lacking
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/e9e85c77dd6abe999785c33e0043ff49c6961f79.png


Why was the GPU usage so high?
The framerate was uncapped. This meant the GPU was working as hard as possible to hit maximum FPS.
If your computer is powerful enough to hit the refresh rate of your monitor (and VSync is on) your GPU wouldn't max out, so you didn't experience this issue.

What were the optimizations? 
I changed render pipelines (Unity HDRP to URP). Something that no one would recommend doing just after launching a game, but it was the hotfix we needed. The new render pipeline has better FPS, better lighting, and it can run on more devices. It feels like an absolute relief.

Mirrors were removed for being absolute framerate killers.

Special thanks to my friend Paul for helping with this update! I'm excited about these improvements, I feel it will make for a much smoother experience. More updates coming soon!
Patrick

notes.title: Week One Update
notes.content:
Summary

Bugs
I had no idea this game would be so popular and that some players would experience such severe issues. I went in full bug-fixing mode and made a ton of progress since its launch.

Bad Performance
Performance is something that I'm actively working on. These are the real reasons for bad graphics performance:

 mirrors require a lot of extra rendering
 cameras placed in the map require a lot of extra rendering (only while in cams room)
 minimap was using a camera (already fixed!)
 multiple cameras running at once (already fixed!)
 lack of basic optimization (ex: the exterior map seems expensive to render)

I will continue working on optimization and adding graphic settings! Sorry for those of you who have experienced issues.

Stats
Over 25,000 players in the first 4 days. Close to 100 reviews with a "Mostly Positive" score at this time.
This far exceeded my expectations, thank you to everyone that's played!

Community

Discord
Big thanks to everyone that's joined our discord! You've been providing bug reports, suggestions, and finding groups to play with. I appreciate you guys, and if you haven't already, join us!

Community Highlight
It has been so awesome watching people play Deduction on Twitch. Show these streamers some love, and please keep making content for us to enjoy!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/ced6f51df39f13cc4a20e2157dcf906cc8dc7a06.png

Community Disappointment
Without tools like mute and kick, it's hard to deal with toxic players. Adding those features has been a very high priority for me. The ultimate goal is for everyone to have a good experience in the game.

This hallway connects Servers to Cams for quick access around the lower level of the map.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/345e1e873b3e7d4e085e3d2af728232585865bf9.png

notes.title: Dev Update #4
notes.content:
Happy October!

New Release Date
There was no way this game would be ready in time for my previously set release date so, I pushed it back to January 10th, 2022. I think this will leave a good amount of time to polish up the game before release. I'm sorry if anyone is disappointed by the delay, but it will allow the game to be greatly improved for launch.

Upcoming Playtest
Steam has recently added a new playtest feature that Deduction will take advantage of. People will signup to participate over time, then I will hold weekend playtests, and those signed up with get notified via email. Hopefully, we get enough players to fill lobbies and have some fun. I'm looking forward to making changes based on feedback from these playtests that will hopefully really improve the game.

notes.content:
Hi everyone,
Thanks for reading this dev update - I'm posting new updates every two weeks.

Recap

My plan was to make all-new character art on the weekend of Sept 12th, but I ended up playing the Age of Empires 4 beta all weekend. It was so dang fun. Also, character art is super hard and I might need to find help to make something I would be proud to have in the game.

This horrifying creation is what resulted from my character art attempt. I might use it as a scary character one day.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/e8e16b72e9611b4682dc35e8f1c7867c789fdc0d.png


Fast forward to this weekend my goal was to overhaul the map art by improving the aesthetics, layout, and adding detail. This went phenomenally well! I accomplished most of the changes I wanted to make, now it's just about polish and adding onto what's there already.

Updated Plans
The next two weeks will be focused on playtesting. I will spend a little time during the week to fix up gameplay bugs and prepare the game as best I can. Then I'll spend the next two weekends fixing bugs, and maybe making some progress on character art (we'll see).

Big thanks to @Slayer0248 and @BigglesthePlainCake for help with playtesting. You guys are greatly appreciated! And thanks to @Alli for their continued support as always!

Patrick
